description.value:
You touch a creature that died no more than a day ago and call it back to life, provided its spirit is both willing and able to return; it awakens with all its hit points restored. This power has no effect on droids or constructs.

The revival seals every wound, purges poison and disease, lifts any curse present at the moment of death, and regenerates missing organs or limbs.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 9
